verdict.rationale: Wave's only documented bulk capability is receipt import, which handles up to 10 receipts at once with OCR extraction. Pro-plan bank feeds auto-import, merge and categorize transactions, but that is background automation rather than a user-driven bulk action. The live GraphQL endpoint is an undocumented developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: bulk edit/categorize/delete across many records, bulk invoice actions, a batch limit above 10, any API or agent-driven bulk operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Scan unlimited receipts and bulk import up to 10 at once to save time.
